tasks.check: deno fmt --check deno.json main.ts main_test.ts src public deno .github/workflows/deno-deploy.yml && deno lint main.ts main_test.ts src deno && deno check --unstable-kv main.ts src/*.ts deno/*.ts && deno test --unstable-kv --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env=HOME,TMPDIR --allow-run=deno main_test.ts deno/prepare_deploy_root_test.ts
tasks.deploy:kv: deno run --allow-read=deno.json --allow-env=DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_0X4007 --allow-net=api.deno.com --allow-run=deno deno/ensure_deno_kv.ts && deno fmt deno.json
tasks.deploy: deno task deploy:prepare && deno task deploy:kv && deno run --allow-env=DENO_DEPLOY_TOKEN_0X4007,GITHUB_SHA,GITHUB_RUN_ID --allow-net=api.deno.com --allow-read=.deploy-root,deno.json deno/deploy_deno_api.ts .deploy-root && deno task deploy:verify
